title: Terms of Use.
sub: How this portfolio site may be used.
html:
Last updated: September 2026

This site (cristofolini.site) is a personal portfolio run by Dhiego Cristofolini. By using it, you agree to these terms.

What this site is

The site shows selected design work, writing, and a contact form. It is not a store, a SaaS product, or a company site. Nothing here is an offer of employment, a partnership, or a paid service unless we agree that in writing.

Content

The writing, case studies, images, and code examples on this site belong to me unless a project credits a client or a third party. You may link to pages here. You may not copy the work, pass it off as yours, or scrape it to train models without asking first.

Contact form

If you write through the form, I will use that message only to reply. How that data is handled is in the Privacy Policy.

No warranty

The site is provided as-is. Case studies describe past work and outcomes; they are not a guarantee of future results. I am not liable for how you use anything you read here.

Changes

I may update these terms. The date at the top of this page is the current version. Questions: dhiegopiresc@gmail.com.
